name: Early Training Evaluation of Language Models
description: This task involves designing evaluation benchmarks to measure the early training progress of small language models (SLMs) in acquiring scientific knowledge, reasoning, and other capabilities. The goal is to provide meaningful performance signals during the early training stages (0-200 billion tokens).

cr:input.name: Pre-trained Small Language Models and Checkpoints
cr:input.description: Three pre-trained small language models (SLMs) with 0.5B, 1B, and 3B parameters, each available in two architectural variants (deep and wide). Intermediate training checkpoints are provided up to 200 billion tokens. Models are trained on two datasets: (1) Web-only Dataset, a subset of FineWeb, and (2) Scientific Knowledge Data Mixture, which includes FineWeb-edu, The Stack V1 and V2, InfiMM, and TxT360. Data is in English and tokenized with a vocabulary size of 65,000 tokens.
